title: Flight Data Recorder — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the flight data recorder in the aft avionics rack, including the isolator torque sequence, the harness free travel check and the recording verification that releases the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the flight data recorder and to verify that the required parameters are being recorded before the aircraft is released.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm that the recorder to be installed carries the frame standard applicable to the aircraft. On post modification aircraft the harness must keep fifteen millimetres of free travel at each isolator, which is the step most often missed and the one that reintroduces the cruise built-in test warning. Get the torque wrench, the antistatic equipment and the readout unit.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the antistatic mat in position and attach the wrist strap. 2. Remove the protective cover from the rack position and do a visual check of the tray and, where fitted, of the four isolators. 3. Lower the recorder squarely into the tray. 4. Install the four fasteners hand tight, then torque in a diagonal sequence to the value in the fits and clearances table. 5. On aircraft post MOD-168036, remove the isolator holding tool and check that fifteen millimetres of free harness travel remains at each isolator. 6. CAUTION: A HARNESS PULLED TIGHT ACROSS AN ISOLATOR DEFEATS THE ISOLATION AND WILL PRODUCE A BUILT-IN TEST WARNING IN CRUISE. 7. Remove the connector cap and connect the recorder. 8. Remove the do-not-close tag and close the circuit breaker. 9. Read the frame identification reported by the recorder and confirm it agrees with the aircraft configuration record. 10. WARNING: DO NOT RELEASE THE AIRCRAFT WITH A RECORDER THAT REPORTS A FRAME STANDARD DIFFERENT FROM THE CONFIGURATION RECORD. THE RECORDING IS NOT COMPLIANT. 11. Do a five minute readout and verify that the required parameters are present. 12. Install the rack protective cover on the adjacent vacant position if applicable.
sections.close_out: Close the avionics bay access. Record the installation, the recorder serial number, the frame identification and the readout result in the aircraft technical log. Return the isolator holding tool and the readout unit to the store.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; steps 5 and 6 apply to aircraft post MOD-168036 only

safety_precautions: Do not release the aircraft with a recorder at the wrong frame standard.
Keep the circuit breaker open until the recorder is secure and connected.
